name: Malefactor Kismet
body:
The Kismet are pleasant folk that attempt to bend luck to provide benefits to those around them.

Karmic Blessing (Ex)

Choose any ally within 30’, as an immediate action you may grant them a luck bonus equal to your Charisma modifier for a single roll. You may use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1.)

This ability replaces aura of misfortune and harrowing strike.
